LightningComponentBundle.description: Lets a buyer redeem loyalty points as a cart discount during checkout.

property.name: webStoreId
property.label: WebStore Id
property.description: Used to resolve the LoyaltyProgram. Leave blank to use the org's primary program.

property.name: cartIdOverride
property.label: Cart Id (override)
property.description: Optional. When placed on the Checkout page the cart is auto-detected from the page context; only set this for testing on a non-checkout page.
